description: Classify a building's seismic standard (旧耐震 / 新耐震 / 2000 wooden standard) from a build year and structure the USER provides, with risk context. This is NOT a safety verdict; direct the user to a professional 耐震診断 via taishin_subsidy_guide.

structure.title: Structure
